text: {"lessons":["I should keep avoiding impulsive reactions to monthly swings, but review the portfolio periodically so a persistent decline does not go unquestioned.","Selling Stock D at a gain felt rewarding; I should still decide to sell based on my goals, valuation and portfolio risk rather than the satisfaction of locking in gains.","The account fell overall despite that profitable sale, so I should diversify and weigh potential losses carefully without letting loss aversion keep me from sensible decisions."]}
